issues.description: The problem statement requires Bookstore to have an initializer init(books: [Book]) but the solution's Bookstore initializer is declared as init(books: Set<Book>) while the Bookstore property is typed as [Book]. This constructor parameter type mismatch (Set vs Array) conflicts with the specification and with how assembleBookstore constructs and passes a [Book] to Bookstore in Client. This inconsistency will confuse students about the expected initializer signature and prevents correct compilation/use without changing either the initializer or the types used elsewhere.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the Bookstore initializer to accept an array of Book to match the problem statement and Client usage: init(books: [Book]) { self.books = books }. Alternatively, if a Set is intended, update the problem statement and all usages (including Client.assembleBookstore) to consistently use Set<Book> and adjust the books property type accordingly.
